get.description: Authenticated personal scope is derived from current role and database-linked user profiles; no client identity override. Without resource returns summary/staff consent options; with resource returns paged minimized records. Staff cannot request personal collections.

200.description: Successful JSON response or protected export (per domain guide).

403.description: Permission, identity scope or origin denied.

post.description: Administrator explicitly links/unlinks existing profiles and matching-role accounts after offline identity verification; changes are audited. Staff requests an immutable source-bound linked-owner acknowledgement. Only that owner decides; no automatic business/financial write or contract execution. Independent agent/staff approvals are still required.

200.description: Successful JSON response or protected export (per domain guide).

201.description: Created request or final nonbinding consent acknowledgement.

403.description: Permission, identity scope or origin denied.

409.description: Source changed or decision already final.

cookieAuth.name: rems_access_token
cookieAuth.description: HttpOnly session transport; fresh identical validation and Origin defense for mutations.

previewHeader.name: X-REMS-Access-Token
previewHeader.description: Same signed JWT, identical validation; no privileged fallback.

userId.description: Active same-organization matching-role account; null explicitly unlinks. Requires admin:manage plus the domain profile write permission.

items.description: Minimized role-scoped source DTO; schema depends on selected collection.

outstandingMinor.description: Recorded invoice balances. Owner value is whole-property balance, not pro-rata payout.
